title: Silent black triangles over Aboriginal communities
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Silent black triangles over Aboriginal communities, about unspecified at Australian Outback, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: who've described black triangles flying over their communities, silent black triangles.

plain: An Australian journalist, Ross Coulthart, says that Aboriginal people, the first peoples of Australia, living in the remote Outback have told of black triangles flying over their communities. According to them, these triangle-shaped craft make no sound at all, which, if true, would point to some unknown aircraft operating over the Outback.
